requirements.name: Agent boundary
requirements.obligation: All admitted agent effects enter through MCP or Zenoh.

requirements.name: Gleam control
requirements.obligation: Agent lifecycle, policy, routing and check verdicts are Gleam-owned.

requirements.name: Canonical intent
requirements.obligation: Both transports carry the same typed intent semantics.

requirements.name: Authority
requirements.obligation: Identity, task attempt, lease, epoch and environment are checked at effect time.

requirements.name: Truthful services
requirements.obligation: Discovery separates declaration, binding, activation and verified availability.

requirements.name: Safe inputs
requirements.obligation: Paths, payloads, encodings, argument vectors and outputs are bounded and validated.

requirements.name: Sa-plan
requirements.obligation: Plans, tasks, jobs and workflows use the canonical authority.

requirements.name: Time
requirements.obligation: UTC, monotonic duration, synchronization and freshness are distinct.

requirements.name: Resources
requirements.obligation: Concurrency, memory, deadlines and cost are explicitly bounded.

requirements.name: OpenRouter
requirements.obligation: Paid/free routing and every retry obey the shared budget and endpoint capability constraints.

requirements.name: Evaluation
requirements.obligation: Environment-specific semantic and native evidence drives model selection.

requirements.name: Holon ecology
requirements.obligation: Every agentic holon discovers shared capabilities and selects authorized activation.

requirements.name: OTP breadth
requirements.obligation: Every installed OTP service is mapped, with activation and effect controls.

requirements.name: Native semantics
requirements.obligation: Generated backends refine the Gleam kernel interpretation.

requirements.name: Native safety
requirements.obligation: ABI, lifetime, resource and scheduler contracts gate NIF use.

requirements.name: Dev isolation
requirements.obligation: Editing, building, testing and failure injection run in development.

requirements.name: Production admission
requirements.obligation: Only verified candidate artifacts and authorized release actions enter production.

requirements.name: Replication
requirements.obligation: All declared recoverable state has explicit replication and restoration coverage.

requirements.name: Leadership
requirements.obligation: Only the current fenced writer may commit effects.

requirements.name: Upgrade
requirements.obligation: Hot loading requires candidate-bound migration and recovery evidence.

requirements.name: Formal semantics
requirements.obligation: Denotations and algebraic laws have invocation-specific evidence.

requirements.name: Observability
requirements.obligation: Each accepted intent produces durable correlated state/evidence.

requirements.name: Symbiosis
requirements.obligation: Client policies, hooks, skills and service contracts stay consistent.

requirements.name: Knowledge
requirements.obligation: Journal/wiki/ZK/KM projections preserve provenance and uncertainty.

requirements.name: Source discipline
requirements.obligation: External trees remain read-only until governed ingestion and admission.

requirements.name: Lifecycle
requirements.obligation: SDLC, SRE, verification and retirement use the same harness authority.

scenarios.name: Agent onboarding
scenarios.expected: Bind a holon; discover usable capabilities and budgets.
scenarios.failure: Unknown identity or missing binding is refused.

scenarios.name: Formal document
scenarios.expected: Read evidence, author specification, validate links/diagrams and publish a receipt.
scenarios.failure: Missing clock/write/check capability produces a visible hold.

scenarios.name: Feature implementation
scenarios.precondition: Coding agent with isolated development workspace
scenarios.expected: Submit intent; harness selects measured eligible coding model; apply reviewed task-scoped changes.
scenarios.failure: Budget, authority or source drift prevents effects.

scenarios.name: Multi-agent work
scenarios.expected: Claim ready tasks; exchange intent/evidence references; serialize integration.
scenarios.failure: Duplicate or expired claims cannot write.

scenarios.name: OCaml kernel
scenarios.precondition: Bounded Gleam kernel and pinned OCaml toolchain
scenarios.expected: Generate native artifact and compare it with the reference semantics.
scenarios.failure: Unsupported construct or unsafe runtime behavior keeps service/reference execution.

scenarios.name: Modular kernel
scenarios.precondition: Typed tensor kernel and observed device capability
scenarios.expected: Generate Mojo/MAX artifact; verify shape, values, memory and performance.
scenarios.failure: Missing device or incompatible artifact refuses the requested acceleration.

scenarios.name: Clock anomaly
scenarios.precondition: A host time correction or stale synchronization receipt
scenarios.failure: Ambiguous UTC or rollback blocks affected effects without inventing a passing clock.

scenarios.name: Exhausted budget
scenarios.precondition: Concurrent requests at the daily boundary
scenarios.expected: Admit only liabilities within the shared allowance.
scenarios.failure: Unknown or lost charge receipts retain liability; no automatic refund.

scenarios.name: Transport replay
scenarios.precondition: Same intent delivered over MCP and Zenoh
scenarios.expected: Return correlated durable status without duplicating the effect.
scenarios.failure: Wrong attempt, stale epoch or late reply is rejected/quarantined.

scenarios.name: Backend crash
scenarios.precondition: A service or bounded kernel fails in development tests
scenarios.expected: Capture typed failure and supervision/recovery evidence.
scenarios.failure: A VM-threatening implementation is excluded from the NIF path.

scenarios.name: Production upgrade
scenarios.precondition: Verified candidate, migrated dev state and release ownership
scenarios.expected: Quiesce affected work; admit compatible OTP upgrade; verify runtime; resume.
scenarios.failure: Incompatible migration uses tested restart/replacement or remains held.

scenarios.name: Primary loss
scenarios.precondition: Replicated committed prefix and exclusive writer fencing
scenarios.expected: Restore eligible standby and reconcile in-flight liabilities.
scenarios.failure: Stale replica or ambiguous leadership stops writes.

scenarios.name: Partition
scenarios.precondition: Primary/standby cannot establish valid writer authority
scenarios.expected: Preserve durable state and refuse ambiguous promotion.
scenarios.failure: Recovery resumes only with a valid fence and reconciled prefix.

scenarios.name: Rollback request
scenarios.expected: Apply the tested recovery relation and verify restored semantics.
scenarios.failure: Irreversible external effects or incompatible state require reconciliation/forward repair.

scenarios.name: Evolution cycle
scenarios.precondition: An admitted bounded task with evidence dependencies
scenarios.expected: Observe, propose, evaluate in dev and record grouped knowledge artifacts.
scenarios.failure: No model result or loop iteration admits a system change.

scenarios.name: Direct-tool attempt
scenarios.precondition: Agent invokes an operational surface outside the harness
scenarios.expected: Reject/intercept and record an Andon event.
scenarios.failure: A client that cannot enforce the boundary remains unadmitted.

retraction.what_was_claimed: A Rete-UL network (alpha/beta join network, token memories, node unlinking).
retraction.what_exists: engines/hermes/modules/hermes_harness/hermes_rete.ml -- a naive forward-chaining matcher whose own header says it is not Rete; and apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/math/rete.gleam -- a salience-ordered list evaluator.
retraction.why_not_implemented: Zero-Muda. Rete exists for 10,000+ rules over 100,000+ churning facts. UOS evaluates about a dozen safety and drift rules sequentially in microseconds. Building a token-memory dataflow graph for that is overproduction, and its retraction and token-memory bugs would be pure defect Muda. The load-bearing property is the fail-closed gate, which the naive matcher already has.
retraction.row_id_preserved_because: Renaming the id would break every traceability reference to it. The claim is retracted in place, which is the honest record; the row's capability_refinement obligation is VIOLATED and says so.

value.default: inactive unless explicitly authorized and observed
value.revoke: Andon/lease expiry/deactivation stop new effects and reconcile in-flight work

activation.rationale: Activation policy is a system-wide rule, not a per-capability fact: every capability is inactive until explicitly authorised and observed, and every one is revoked by Andon, lease expiry or deactivation.

value.principal: Authenticated transport or explicitly scoped trusted local launcher
value.fence: Current lease, epoch, role and dependencies at effect boundary
value.atomicity: Cooperative observations unless a stronger bound is independently verified

authority.rationale: The authority predicate is uniform by construction. Principal, task binding, fence and atomicity come from the harness's single authority path (SC-HARNESS-MCP-001), so a per-row value would be a copy, not a declaration.

value.standby: Verified production role; never implicit dev promotion

roles.rationale: Role semantics are constitutional (spec section 9) and identical for every capability. Only the literal role "development" exists in code; production and standby have no representation, which is a system fact, not a per-row one.

value.deadline: Finite deadline; partial-frame and backend bounds are separate
value.freshness: Reference age, delivery age and effect evidence age are separate

clock.rationale: Clock domains, freshness and deadline are properties of the harness clock service, which every capability shares. A per-row clock declaration would assert an independence the implementation does not have.

value.schema: Typed MCP intent; Zenoh parity remains unverified
value.correlation: Stable intent/effect ID plus receipt identity
value.logical_effect_id: Independent of current task attempt; attempts fence authority, not deduplication

transport.rationale: Correlation, logical effect id and schema are transport-level, set once by the MCP/Zenoh adapter. transport.availability stays per row because it genuinely differs.

value.recovery: Typed failure; isolate backend; reconcile uncertain effects

supervision.rationale: HOISTED WITH A RECORDED DEFECT: the owner and recovery text is uniform policy, but supervision.bounds says explicit per-capability restart/concurrency/time/memory ceilings are REQUIRED and none is declared for any capability. Finding R2-2 is open; this default records the obligation rather than 30 copies pretending it is met.

value.writer: Declared single authoritative writer or verified concurrency protocol
value.durability: Capability-specific durable state and uncertain-effect ledger required
value.replication: UNKNOWN until observed under declared protocol

state.rationale: HOISTED WITH A RECORDED OBLIGATION: writer, durability, replication and restore carried one identical placeholder on all 30 rows. state.schema stays per row because it is genuinely distinct. The four hoisted fields are outstanding per-capability obligations, listed in per_capability_obligations_outstanding.

denotation_errors.rationale: The closed error set of the capability denotation. It is the same six for every capability by design -- that is what makes it a denotation rather than an ad-hoc return type.

effect_scope.value: Finite task-declared resources; no ambient effect authority
effect_scope.rationale: Ambient authority is barred system-wide. Restating it per row asserts nothing extra.

version.rationale: Every row is at the atlas's own initial version. Per-row versions begin only when a row is independently revised.

backend_placeholders.rationale: OUTSTANDING: abi, artifact_digest and toolchain carried one placeholder on all 30 rows. They are real per-backend facts that have not been observed. Recorded as outstanding rather than duplicated.

evidence_flags.rationale: admitted is false for every capability (admission ceiling EV-93, SC-PROVENANCE-001). candidate and recovery_receipt are outstanding observations, uniform because none has been made.

resources_policy.rationale: OUTSTANDING: per-capability resource bounds and privacy class are required by spec section 21 and none is declared. Recorded once as an open obligation.

algebra_note.value: One obligation per formal-spec-section-3 structure. Status UNKNOWN means exactly that: the obligation is recorded and unproven. It is not a pass. Machine-checked by engines/hermes/modules/hermes_toolchain/atlas_check.ml.
algebra_note.rationale: How to read every obligation. Uniform by definition -- it describes the schema, not a capability.

aspects_provenance.value: Author-assigned from formal spec section 7 by reading this row's denotation and effect class. Not independently reviewed; falsify by finding a code path for this capability that touches an unlisted aspect.
aspects_provenance.rationale: How every aspect assignment was made. Uniform because one author made them all in one pass; it is provenance, not a per-capability fact.

per_capability_obligations_outstanding.why: spec section 8 requires a declared single authoritative writer or a verified concurrency protocol per state item

spec section 8 requires a replication position; finding R2-1 and the state.replication row's VIOLATED obligation both bear on this
spec section 8 requires tested restore evidence; none exists
the ABI each backend actually presents, observed not declared
the digest of the artifact actually loaded
the pinned toolchain that produced the artifact

bounded_domain_rationale: These are categorical fields with a small legitimate domain. Most capabilities genuinely share a value, so a repeat-ratio ceiling would report degeneracy that is not there and would push an author to invent variation. They are judged instead by the finer rule that more than one value must actually occur.
